# OdooWebApps

> A web app studio for businesses that already use Odoo. We build small, focused web apps that connect to an existing Odoo instance through Odoo's external API (JSON-2 on Odoo 19; JSON-RPC and XML-RPC on earlier versions). We do not replace Odoo, and we are not an Odoo implementation partner. Run by Tal Oz, on 5+ years of hands-on Odoo implementation and automation work. Last updated 23 September 2026.

Odoo already does everything a business generally needs: accounting, inventory, sales, purchasing, manufacturing and master data. Odoo stays the single source of truth. We build the narrow interface layer around it: a mobile picking screen, a sales rep's ordering app, a dashboard, a customer or supplier portal, or a one-off custom workflow, each connected to Odoo's data through its API, with no custom code installed inside Odoo.

Facts: the Work page describes nine shipped, in-production apps and automations for our clients (a group of companies in food production, wholesale, retail and catering on Odoo 18; anonymised). The demos on the site are working apps built the same way we build client apps, reading a bundled snapshot of Odoo's own demo dataset, with the ORM call and record count printed under each one and the source labelled "snapshot" on screen. Prices: a single focused screen from $390; a polished multi-screen app typically $490 to $890; bigger systems quoted on scope. Apps can be read-only or read/write against Odoo records. Every project is scoped and quoted after a conversation about the actual workflow.

## Use-case pages

- [Odoo Warehouse App](https://odoowebapps.com/odoo-warehouse-app): Mobile-first picking app connected to Odoo Inventory (stock.picking / stock.move.line). From $590.
- [Odoo Sales App](https://odoowebapps.com/odoo-sales-app): Mobile ordering app for field sales reps, creates Odoo sale.order records. From $690.
- [Odoo Dashboard](https://odoowebapps.com/odoo-dashboard): Read-only management dashboard surfacing live sales, margin, inventory and purchasing numbers from Odoo. From $490.
- [Odoo Customer Portal](https://odoowebapps.com/odoo-customer-portal): Branded customer ordering portal connected to Odoo Sales, for fast repeat ordering. From $890.
- [Odoo Supplier Portal](https://odoowebapps.com/odoo-supplier-portal): Portal for suppliers to confirm/update Odoo purchase orders without direct Odoo access. From $790.
- [Custom Odoo Web App](https://odoowebapps.com/custom-odoo-web-app): One-screen custom workflow apps (approvals, single-purpose data entry) for whatever doesn't fit the other categories. From $390.
- [Odoo API Development](https://odoowebapps.com/odoo-api-development): The integration layer itself: connecting external apps, portals, or other systems to Odoo's external API (JSON-2, JSON-RPC, XML-RPC). Priced per project.

## Work (anonymised, in production)

- [Work overview](https://odoowebapps.com/work): nine shipped apps and automations for one group of companies on Odoo 18, with the Odoo models each one touches.
- [Barcode picking for the warehouse floor](https://odoowebapps.com/work#barcode-picking): stock.picking, stock.move.line, stock.lot; checks lot expiry as lines are picked.
- [Wholesale ordering portal for B2B customers](https://odoowebapps.com/work#wholesale-ordering-portal): sale.order, product.pricelist; per-customer catalogue and warehouse-scoped stock.
- [Kitchen production board](https://odoowebapps.com/work#kitchen-production-board): mrp.production, stock.warehouse.orderpoint; read-only board driven by automatic MOs.
- [Container and shipment planning](https://odoowebapps.com/work#container-planning): purchase.order, product.packaging; 2,855 products, 1,312 measured cartons, 974 automated tests.
- [Catering orders across companies](https://odoowebapps.com/work#catering-orders): sale.order, res.company.
- [HACCP quality forms tied to production](https://odoowebapps.com/work#quality-forms): mrp.production.
- [Expense submission from the phone](https://odoowebapps.com/work#expenses): hr.expense.
- [Delivery board across cities](https://odoowebapps.com/work#delivery-board): stock.picking, res.partner, sale.order; booked to in transit to delivered, with status posting back to Odoo.
- [Digests and automations inside Odoo](https://odoowebapps.com/work#digests-and-automations): ir.cron, mail.template.

## Guides

- [Odoo API examples: what a call looks like, and what takes the time](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-api-examples-python-javascript): What an Odoo API call looks like in JSON-2, JSON-RPC and XML-RPC, which transport your version needs, and why the calls are the easy part: access rights, write-back safety, speed and staying working are the real project.
- [Odoo 19's JSON-2 API: what changed, and what to do about XML-RPC](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-19-json-2-api): Odoo 19 added an HTTP JSON API at /json/2/<model>/<method> with bearer API keys, and scheduled XML-RPC and JSON-RPC for removal in Odoo 22. The request shape, the plan gate, key rotation, the one-call-one-transaction rule and a migration table.
- [Odoo API keys: how to create, scope and rotate them](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-api-key-setup): Where to generate an Odoo API key, how it is sent on JSON-2 versus XML-RPC, the three-month limit in Odoo 19, which user should hold it, and the six reasons a key usually fails.
- [Odoo customization vs a custom web app: what's the difference?](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-customization-vs-custom-apps): How in-Odoo customization (views, studio, custom modules) differs from building a separate web app against Odoo's API, and how to tell which one a given problem actually needs.
- [How Odoo's API actually works (JSON-2, JSON-RPC, XML-RPC and the ORM)](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-api-integration-explained): A practical explanation of Odoo's external API: JSON-2 on Odoo 19, JSON-RPC and XML-RPC before it, API-key authentication, and the ORM methods (search_read, create, write) a custom app calls.
- [What happens to a custom app when Odoo upgrades?](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/what-happens-when-odoo-upgrades): Why a separate web app is affected differently by an Odoo version upgrade than in-Odoo customizations are, and what actually needs to be checked when Odoo moves versions.
- [How much does a custom Odoo app cost?](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/how-much-does-a-custom-odoo-app-cost): A grounded look at what drives the price of a small Odoo-connected app, with real ranges instead of vague 'contact us for pricing.'
- [Signs your team needs a simpler interface than Odoo's backend](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/signs-your-team-needs-a-simpler-odoo-interface): Practical signals, from workarounds on paper to reluctant adoption, that indicate a workflow would benefit from a focused front end instead of more Odoo training.
- [Read-only vs write-back Odoo integrations: which do you need?](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-write-back-vs-read-only-integrations): The difference between an app that only displays Odoo data and one that creates or updates records in Odoo, and why that distinction changes scope, risk and cost.
- [Odoo REST API: what exists in Odoo 19, and what came before](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-rest-api-explained): Odoo 19 has an HTTP JSON API (JSON-2) with bearer API keys; older versions only have XML-RPC and JSON-RPC, deprecated for removal in Odoo 22. What each looks like and which to use.
- [Odoo barcode app: use Odoo's, or build a custom one?](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-barcode-app-buy-or-build): Odoo's own Barcode app is genuinely capable. An honest look at when it's enough and when a narrower custom picking app makes more sense.
- [How to give customers a self-service portal without rebuilding Odoo's frontend](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-customer-self-service-portal): The difference between Odoo's built-in customer portal and a fully custom-branded ordering portal, and how to tell which one a given business actually needs.
- [Hiring an Odoo developer vs a web app studio: what's the difference?](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-developer-vs-web-app-studio): An honest, even-handed comparison of when an Odoo developer or implementation partner is the right call, and when a narrow web app studio is the better fit instead.
- [Odoo Studio can't do this: where the no-code builder hits a wall](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-studio-limitations): What Odoo Studio is genuinely good at, where its no-code approach hits real limits, and when a workflow needs a different kind of interface entirely.
- [Odoo implementation partner cost, and when you don't need one](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-implementation-partner-cost): Honest, hedged ranges for what a full Odoo implementation typically costs, and how to tell whether your actual problem needs one or just a single connected app.
- [Why your Odoo dashboard is slow, and when a standalone one fixes it](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/why-is-my-odoo-dashboard-slow): The real technical reason cross-module Odoo dashboards and reports can be slow, and how a standalone read-only dashboard app sidesteps that specific problem.
- [Purchase approvals stuck in Odoo's backend? A simple mobile approve or reject app](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-purchase-approval-mobile-app): Why purchase order approvals bottleneck when managers are away from a desktop, and how a minimal mobile approve/reject screen writes decisions straight back to Odoo.
- [Why your Odoo API call returns data from the wrong company](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/odoo-api-multi-company-filtering): A recurring multi-company Odoo API gotcha: queries can return records across every company a user can access unless the request explicitly scopes company context.
- [Reps won't use Odoo on their phones? Build the three screens they actually need](https://odoowebapps.com/guides/why-sales-reps-dont-use-odoo-mobile): Why desktop-first CRM/Sales interfaces see low adoption from field reps on phones, and why a narrow 3-screen order flow written back to Odoo works better.
